title: Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure
abstract: arXiv:2609.24012v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Validation of generative social simulators often stops at face validity: emergent network structure is compared descriptively, without quantified parameter uncertainty or an adequacy check. We present an adequacy-aware calibration protocol that couples amortized posterior estimation with a synthetic identifiability assessment, a matched-sample-size adequacy check (prior-predictive reachability plus per-statistic posterior-predictive localization), a diagnosis-guided repair, and a statistic-held-out audit. We demonstrate it on a real second-hand luxury resale market with four channel-by-residency cells, each a bipartite buyer-brand network, using a forward model built from persona profiles elicited once, offline, by a language model. The behavioural parameters are recoverable in all four cells, though calibration is approximate and overconfident for one parameter. translated_title: 检验而非假定充分性：基于涌现网络结构校准生成式社会模拟器
translated_abstract: 生成式社会模拟器的验证往往止步于表面效度：涌现网络结构仅被描述性地比较，缺乏量化的参数不确定性或充分性检验。我们提出了一种充分性感知的校准协议，该协议将摊销后验估计与合成可辨识性评估、匹配样本量的充分性检验（先验预测可达性加上逐统计量的后验预测定位）、诊断引导的修复以及统计量留出审计相结合。我们在一个真实的二手奢侈品转售市场上演示了该方法，该市场包含四个按渠道和居住地划分的单元格，每个单元格都是一个二分的买家-品牌网络，并使用由语言模型一次性离线诱导的人格画像构建的前向模型。行为参数在所有四个单元格中均可恢复，尽管对其中一个参数的校准是近似的且过度自信。观测到的摘要统计量落在模拟器的可达性参考范围之外。
tldr: 提出一种充分性感知的校准协议，将摊销后验估计与可辨识性评估、匹配样本量充分性检验、诊断引导修复和留出统计量审计相结合，以严格校准生成式社会模拟器，并在真实二手奢侈品转售市场的二分网络上验证了行为参数的可恢复性。
en_tdlr: An adequacy-aware calibration protocol combining amortized posterior estimation with identifiability assessment, matched-sample-size adequacy checks, diagnosis-guided repair, and statistic-held-out auditing is proposed to rigorously calibrate generative social simulators, validated on real second-hand luxury resale market bipartite networks with recoverable behavioral parameters.
